item.title: New Serpent SRX8GTE R Electric GT Chassis
item.description: The SRX8GTE R represents the pinnacle of performance in electric GT racing, with a singular focus: to enhance speed!

item.title: New Reedy Stockstar Competition LiPo Batteries
item.description: Reedy Power, a leading innovator in high-performance electronics for R/C cars, is proud to announce the launch of their all-new Stockstar battery line. Specifically designed to meet the demanding power requirements of stock class RC car racing.

item.title: New Inov8 3DX Carbon Car Stand
item.description: Inov8 is excited to introduce their latest product, the INOV8 3DX Carbon Car Stand.

item.title: New Upgrade RC Short Course Pre-Mounts
item.description: UpGrade RC is pleased to announce four new 1/10 scale short course pre-mounted tires now available at AMainHobbies.com or your local hobby shop.

item.title: New Upgrade RC Traxxas Modified Wraps
item.description: The UPG “Apex” wrap series features five high-impact visual designs that will transform the look of your Traxxas Modified immediately.

item.title: Sutherland Signs With Team Exalt
item.description: Team Exalt is proud to officially welcome Nate Sutherland to the Exalt family for 2026 and beyond.

item.title: New Intellect Power MC4 Batteries
item.description: Intellect’s new MC4 line brings increased capacity and improved internal resistance, delivering stronger and more consistent power output across the whole runtime. Ideal for racers and performance drivers who want reliable punch and long runtime.

item.title: Neoland 2026 Registration Open
item.description: Neoland is born as the continuation of one of the greatest races in the world, where the best drivers have left their mark in every edition. Registration is now open.

item.title: New Team Associated B84 and B84D Classic Editions
item.description: Unleash unparalleled performance with the RC10B84 & RC10B84D, a 1/10-scale 4WD buggy engineered for precision, speed, and racetrack victories kitted in the RC10 Classic-inspired livery, premium composite plastics, and aluminum parts.

item.title: New ALF1 Racing Designs ALF1'26 Builders Kit
item.description: Designed for the serious racer, this ALF1 10th scale formula 1 kit combines cutting-edge materials like carbon fiber, 7075 aluminum, and advanced 3D-printed composites to deliver an unparalleled balance of low center of gravity, rigidity, tuning.
